name: Remove the leftover Rust workspace
body: Dean (2026-11-18): the repository still has Cargo and Rust files; can it be entirely Nox and Mist based? Audit: nothing builds or runs the Rust workspace any more. `mist run` (game, editor, test, build-shaders, graphs), engine/tools/*.sh and the editor and native CMake builds never touch Cargo, and there is no CI. The workspace (crates/, apps/lantern, examples/frame-loop, tools/asset-gen, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rustfmt.toml, root shaders/*.wgsl) is the pre-port engine. Its C++ pieces (crates/chaos-ui/native, crates/editor-backend/include) are older copies of engine/native and engine/editor-backend. Open question: tools/asset-gen is the only generator of assets/ placeholder textures, sounds and gem.glb (D-008); removing it makes the committed files the source of truth. Provisional: remove it. The rust-*.trace goldens under engine/tests stay as frozen fixtures.
plan: Delete the Rust workspace and its root files, drop /target from .gitignore, and update README, engine/README, docs/architecture.md, docs/README.md, docs/engine-structure.md and decisions.md so they describe a Nox and Mist repository. Record the asset-gen decision. Run `mist run test`.
acceptance_criteria: No Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, *.rs or rustfmt.toml remain
Docs no longer tell the reader to run cargo
